text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
A loooong time ago on New Year's Eve, two 
Umamusume shrine maidens went to a pond in 
the mountain behind the shrine, and the 
crane and turtle living there said to 
them:

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Please let us see the first sunrise from 
the mountain peak." 
With the turtle being slow of foot, and 
the crane lacking the strength to carry 
it,

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The crane turned the red crest on its head 
into flame to light the way. When the 
maidens carried the turtle to the top, 
the morning sun turned the turtle into a 
beautiful mirror, and the crane into a 
paper lantern.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The shrine maidens brought them back to 
enshrine as sacred artifacts, bathing them 
in the first sunrise once a year to 
celebrate the New Year together.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...And that is the origin of this ritual. 
The essential "core," if you will.

As the repairs progressed, borrowing a 
room in the shrine office, 
the discussion on "how to adapt the 
ritual" continued...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That antique mirror used to be a 
turtleーー!? 
In that case, we absolutely have to take 
that little guy to the mountain peak!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Totally. Substituting it with a small 
mirror is out of the question. It'll be 
heavy, but let's do our best to carry it! 
And instead of flashlights, real fire 
seems better for light, even if it's a bit 
dimmer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! If fire alone is too dim, 
how about equipping the shrine maidens 
with night vision goggles?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Th-That's way too high-tech! There's no 
elegance in that at all! 
The spectators would be totally 
bewildered!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes! If this event is all about 
celebrating the New Year, 
then the more fun festivities we have, the 
better, right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Let's set up food stalls! And a cute live 
stage♪ 
And then~, a raffle shop where you can win 
magical items!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
As long as it feels "befitting the New 
Year," I agree with having festivities. 
Let me see... A mochi toss would be quite 
appropriate.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Things are really coming 
together...! Let's keep this momentum 
going and hammer out the fine details!

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, I see... These are all fine 
"updates." 
Young and old alike should be able to 
enjoy this. Now then, who will play the 
shrine maidens...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah! We haven't decided that yet, have we?! 
Hmm, what should we do? 
Should we just play rock-paper-scissors to 
keep it fair... maybe?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What?! No way, it's an important role! 
We're going to settle this properly 
through competition, no hard feelings!

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Oho! In that case, I found something nice 
in the storehouse earlier~. Look here...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Wah, is this hanetsuki gear?

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Back in the day, we used to set out New 
Year's toys in the shrine grounds every 
year 
so the worshipers could play with them.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great! Let's settle it with this! 
How about the top two from a round-robin 
tournament get to be the Uma Shrine 
Maidens!?

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho, full of spirit, aren't we~! 
And on top of that, something like this 
turned up too...

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaa, long-sleeved kimonos from when 
the girls were young. Still pretty, aren't 
they? 
It's not much of a thank-you, but they're 
made of good material, so please take them 
if you like.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wah, so pretty! Are you sure? 
Hey, hey, let's try them on right away!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wait, what about the hanetsuki match?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's why we're putting them on! Don't 
you want to move around once you try them 
on? 
It's a dress rehearsal for New Year's♪ 
Come on! Everyone, hurry upーー!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ーーTaaaaahh!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Haah! And that decides it!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa!! Take that! I gotchaーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho, looks like the gear works without 
any problems~. 
Let's see, might as well tune up the 
spinning tops and kites too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I did it! That secures my spot as 
a shrine maiden♪ 
Now, who will be the other Uma Shrine 
Maiden, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Me, of course! Who else would it be!? 
Take this! Sweepy☆Magical Shuuut!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whaーー! B-But I want to do it with 
Dia-chan too...! 
Wait, Sweep-san, why are you trying so 
hard~!? Uuuughーー!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I won't... LOOOOSEーー! 
I'M going to be the Uma Shrine 
Maiden~~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahahahahaーー!! 
Fufufuーー!

And so... after a fierce battle, 
Satono Diamond and Kitasan Black were 
chosen as the Uma Shrine Maidens!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Yayーー! Wait, ah, it's already 
evening...? 
The sun goes down so fast in winter...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(How strange... I'm having so much fun, 
but I feel so strange... 
Like... I wish we could just keep playing 
like this forever...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Pheeew~~, that was intense~. And it's not 
even New Year's yet.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it really was! I had so much fun. 
...I feel like we've gotten a lot closer 
with the seniors than when we first 
started, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-chan. You may only jog up to a trot 
on public roads~. 
If you want to run, wait until you're on 
the Umamusume lane.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Jeez! I know that already, bleeeh! 
Grass, why do you treat me like a kid, not 
just Spe!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Eh! I'm not being treated like a kid, am 
I~?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait for New Year's. So much has 
happened this past year. 
I wonder what next year will be like...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"You know, life's been so fulfilling 
lately, but there's still so much more I 
want to do. 
And... actually, truth is... hehe, lean in 
a bit, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Someday, I'd love to go race in France. 
It's still a really far-off dream, 
though..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Ehehe, keep it a secret from everyone 
else, okay? 
I'd rather tell them once it starts 
feeling a little more real."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"France...? You'd go there? All by 
yourself...?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Huh? Going on an overseas campaign is 
just... something I'd love to try someday, 
you know?"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Ah... no, it's just... Dia-chan, you're 
aiming for somewhere so far away... that's 
all..."

text_block_list.name: Both as Children
text_block_list.text:
Pinky promise, cross my heart! 
From now on, together...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"(I know 'always together' doesn't just 
mean physically being in the same place. 
But still... it feels like everything is 
slowly drifting apart...)"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(We really can't stay the way we are 
forever, can we...?)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My, my... This is a bit more than I 
expected...
